WITH id_counts AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
), shares AS (
  SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM id_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(s.record_count) AS average_record_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
